papers.title: Epistemic Navigation in Open Worlds
papers.current_ceiling: Three non-synthetic regime classes are supported on main; a separate 5/5 prospective Python import-density packet exists on #1716 but is not canonically bound on main.
post_matrix_updates: Issue #1730 owns the path-by-path P7 V2 binding and the subsequent naturalistic navigation successor.
load_bearing_adverse: The 5/5 requests/networkx/django/tornado/sympy outcome cannot earn a main-line box until binding/governance are reconciled.
E14 repositories are accessed historical evidence and cannot be fresh successor outcomes.
Import density is a proxy mechanism, not a naturalistic multi-stage navigation terminal or external-investigator replication.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: After canonicalizing the existing prospective packet without changing it, a new organization-disjoint study must test witness-aware multi-stage navigation under real regime changes and native success criteria.
papers.decisive_question: In organization-disjoint multi-stage change episodes, does prospectively measured dependency/obligation structure predict which evidence and closures must be revisited better than density-only, value-only and always-reopen policies?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Witness-aware navigation provides a transferable law for preserving and reopening scientific state across naturalistic multi-stage regime changes.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: A frozen structural score combining dependency reachability and changed obligations should predict minimal necessary reopenings and avoid unsafe carry-forward across new repositories and regime types.
papers.population_or_universe: New organization-disjoint repositories/workflows not in E14, containing multi-stage representation, responsibility or objective changes with native-verifier or external gold.
papers.unit_of_analysis: One regime-change episode with pre-change state, change sequence, obligations and gold reopen/preserve decisions.
design: Phase A: land #1716 path-by-path using only sanctioned additive P7 V2 binding.
Phase B: freeze new organizations, change episodes and native gold before outcome access.
Require at least two qualitatively different change classes and multi-stage paths.
Compare density-only, value-only, always-reopen and authoritative graph/obligation baselines.
Measure unsafe preservation, unnecessary reopening and path-level success.
negative_controls: Same density with different obligation change.
Same value with different dependency path.
Historical E14 episode inserted as a leakage canary.
analysis_plan: Episode-level paired comparison and organization-level cluster uncertainty.
The 5/5 packet is reported as prior prospective evidence, not included in the new estimate.
No naturalistic claim until native/external gold is available.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Freeze all eligible episodes under the new organization rule; ensure at least two change classes and enough organizations for leave-one-organization-out analysis.
papers.success_gate: Zero unsafe carry-forward, fewer unnecessary reopenings than always-reopen and stronger path prediction than every proxy baseline across multiple organizations/change classes.
papers.refutation_gate: Any unsafe carry-forward or parity with the authoritative donor product limits the result to the existing bounded/prospective density mechanism.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if #1716 binding is unresolved, organization disjointness fails, native gold is ambiguous or E14 leaks into fresh confirmation.
papers.authority_required: Native verifiers/maintainers or blinded external adjudicators plus an independently implemented navigation checker.

active_lane.collision_rule: Do not duplicate P7 binding or define a parallel successor; E14 stays historical-only.

immediate_safe_actions: Review #1716 file-by-file for exact evidence preservation.
Draft an organization-disjoint naturalistic eligibility rule inside #1730.
Define native gold for multi-stage reopen/preserve decisions.
forbidden_actions: Do not treat unmerged evidence as main-line authority.
Do not reuse E14 as fresh holdout.
Do not call import-density prediction naturalistic navigation or external replication.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier navigation/continual-science paper needs canonical prospective evidence, organization-disjoint naturalistic paths, native gold, strong structural baselines and safety-first endpoints.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns navigation/regime transport; graph-quality revalidation mechanics belong to ORION-16.
